title: Candidate-6 review remediation (reports/plugin-m1-review-candidate-6-2026-09-13): F01 a `#` comment ends at its line so the newline after it refuses; F01/F02a any `$` expansion outside single quotes refuses (`"$FLAG"` = --help, `"$FILE"` = another checkout); F07 a close with no rollup keeps the session's stored usage in the summary (server); plan workflow pushes the PLAN artifact and never fabricates approval; end workflow's optional mints never block the close

claude.rationale: The lexer holes live in the shared classifier both hosts' receipts run through; the regenerated /jentrix-plan pushes the PLAN and states the headless rule, /jentrix-end makes optional mints non-blocking and names the two new refusals. F07 is a server change (task-manager src/server/agent-sessions/summary.ts) with no host-side code.

codex.rationale: Same shared classifier and the same regenerated $jentrix-plan / $jentrix-end skill text; Codex trials run the identical workflow sources.
